greeting.text: Nozel Silva, captain of the Silver Eagle. State your business, or do not. I have little interest either way.
A new delver. Do not expect special treatment because you stand on royal ground. Do expect honesty.
Hmph. At least you do not shout. That puts you ahead of most.
I have heard of you, {player}. Do not let it go to your head.

hint.text: Mercury flows into every gap. A defence with no gap is worth more than ten attacks. Remember that.
Do not mistake courage for competence. The dungeon punishes the first and rewards the second.
Pride is not strength. But strength that does not know its worth is wasted. I speak from experience.
Family is a matter of effort, not blood. ...Forget that I said that.
A telegraphed blow is a gift. Anyone who dies to one has only himself to blame.
Armour, barrier, mercury: choose what suits you, then trust it. Doubt kills faster than any blade.
No champions defeated. Then you have much to prove. Begin by surviving the first one.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun means to rewrite this kingdom. I do not intend to let them. Neither should you.
The Eye has lost another piece. Continue.
Spade Kingdom gravity can pin even armour. Do not lean on silver or steel to bear a weight meant for resolve.
If you intend to face Lucius, do it as a unit. A single blade will not matter.
The Chronicle holds strangers now. Fine. I will judge them as I judge everyone: by what they do under pressure.
